generations.name: All-New LEAF – crossover, MY2025 UK sheet

sourceNotes: Existing line facts retained from the earlier reviewed snapshot; unknown regional dates remain null.
Datsun and Prince are distinct badge phases; their predecessor models are not copied wholesale under Nissan.
Historical museum year means a particular specimen, not an inferred model start/end date.
Existing Atleon/Cabstar/Trade references preserved for compatibility; no expansion into heavy commercial catalogue.
gaps: Most 43 inherited families still need deeper historical and technical coverage; this is not a complete global Nissan production catalogue.
Datsun-era Bluebird/Sunny/Cherry/Fairlady, Nissan Silvia versus existing 200 SX and regional Maxima/Cefiro relationships need further badge-level reconciliation.
Domestic Elgrand/Teana/Stagea/Sentras/kei and many other model families remain outside this bounded addition.
Priority Almera/Primera/Note historical engine tables remain incomplete unless explicitly supplied by the version module.
President museum webpage has a displacement typo (1998 cc versus text 4.5 litres); no disputed engine row is copied.
Photo searches are bounded, not exhausted; null references do not prove suitable Commons photos absent.
excluded: Prince-badged predecessor Skylines/Glorias and Datsun-badged prewar/early postwar lines are not duplicated as Nissan production.
Racing-only R-series prototypes, concept cars and one-off show cars excluded.

checks: Strict TypeScript CatalogModelCard[] and CatalogModelLine[] assignment
Unique slugs, source URLs, chronological bounds, all null fields indexed in needsReview

rootBackfill80.note: Whole-vehicle Commons illustrations inspected individually; scope and angle exceptions annotated; no version facts changed.
